title: limonium inarimense subsp. ebusitanum
intro:
Limonium inarimense subsp. ebusitanum, commonly known as a type of sea lavender, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Limonium inarimense subsp. ebusitanum include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
